review.maintenanceAssessment: WP03.01 extends the existing public Foundation/PublicApi schema, validator, typed value and fixture surface without adding any third-party package or upgrading a framework. The reviewed third-party closure remains exactly140 admitted immutable coordinates with existing licences and integrity. PublicApi now depends on the existing Foundation package; evaluated import/distribution ownership and downstream project locks reflect this owner-local change. Required candidate/security checks, source provenance and provider publication gates remain enforced. The CI repair retains every dependency coordinate and lock: linear URL validation and focused tests replace the vulnerable regex; the protobuf Dokka publication suppresses inherited runtime members whose links incorrectly alias unrelated records. Declared record/field API markers, fixed resources and component licences remain unchanged. Immutable bindings-r4 and documentation-r6 successors retain their predecessors.

checks.compilation: C# Release source solution and IsAotCompatible analysis passed with existing SDK10.0.401 using the admitted ILLink10.0.11 cache; committed SDK10.0.400 remains required CI. All five TS workspaces compiled with pinned Node24.21/npm11.19 and existing locked dependencies. Kotlin/Java public modules compiled using cached JDK17/Gradle9.7.1. No toolchain installed. The changed generated validators were compiled and their focused link regression tests passed in C# and TypeScript.
checks.aot-trim: The complete source build passed AOT/trim static analysis without suppressions. Typed ID/value adapters use generated protobuf messages and explicit checked conversions. Native AOT executable compilation and full serialization registration remain WP03.02; no native executable/device acceptance is claimed.
checks.compatibility: Frozen19-message/3-enum published Foundation baseline, complete148-message closure, all82 oneof alternatives and69 nominal ID domains passed the targeted static gate and eight negative drift cases. Existing package identities, service names, wire tags and enums remain compatible. PublicApi adds only its owner-local Foundation dependency; compiler-based access gate and14 negative tests passed.
checks.licence-provenance: All new schemas, rule helpers, adapters and independent fixtures are Apache-2.0. Generated contract and Dokka documentation successor records retain immutable predecessors and third-party generator/resource evidence. Third-party versions, archive integrity and140-coordinate licence closure are unchanged. Candidate licence/provenance/SBOM gates remain required before publication. A CI documentation oracle failure exposed wrong cross-type inherited runtime links. One corrected offline documentation generation retains every declared API marker and strict page/resource admission; no archive or public package was downloaded.
checks.security-sbom: Existing dependency review, npm/NuGet audit, CodeQL and redacted secret scan remain required on latest PR head. No security gate is bypassed or duplicated. Per-package SBOM and one producer content/handoff identity check remain required; a redundant positive documentation archive rescan was removed while mutated negative unit cases are retained. The reported polynomial-regex finding is repaired at its generator source. Exact public SHA256 secret-scan exceptions preserve the default rules and remain limited to reviewed paths/rows.
checks.runtime-performance-migration: 476 independent cases passed in both C# and TS, including314 positive bidirectional binary exchanges,148 messages,82 union alternatives,45 error categories and10 authored wire oracles; nominal type negative compilation passed. Prior90 C#/70 applicable TS shape cases and retained source wire tests passed. No live RPC, browser/device/GUI, installed consumer, AI inference or product engine was run.
checks.framework-runtime-posture: No framework or third-party coordinate upgrade. Local SDK401 selects the existing linker10.0.11 solely to match committed restore inputs; pinned CI SDK400 and all lock integrity remain unchanged. Kotlin compilation is JVM source coverage, not Android ART/R8/device behavior. Owner performance/storage/query/DSP/migration gates remain later work.
